concept.title: Branching Governance and Conventions
concept.shortdesc: Branching strategies establish consistent naming patterns and isolate active development from production-ready code.

conbody.p: In , long-lived default branches are protected from direct commits to preserve release stability.
Contributors must isolate changes in short-lived feature or bugfix branches adhering to standardized naming prefixes:

ul.li: feature/: Work supporting new capabilities, APIs, or major documentation updates.
fix/: Targeted repairs for reported defects or incorrect guidance.
docs/: Minor prose improvements, typo corrections, or maintenance.
